scope: Prospective acceptance matrix only;not executed tests or implementation approval

cases.name: source_values
cases.requirement: Accept direct4.7/4.3/12.7/26.2 literals with source symbols and full unknowns

cases.name: zero_and_hundred
cases.requirement: Accept reported0 and100 as numbers,without physical-zero or extraction-completeness certification;dash never numeric

cases.name: uncertainty_roles
cases.requirement: Allow absolute nonnegative spread above100 on dedicated role;relative percent separately preserved;do not apply central100cap to spread

cases.name: closed_shape
cases.requirement: Missing mandatory definition/fact,unknown text notnull,blank notes or contradictory status rejected

cases.name: primary_evidence
cases.requirement: Reported method fields require source/document method+condition support;unknowns require inspected primary condition evidence;secondary source does not substitute

cases.name: legacy_isolation
cases.requirement: Existing24branch objects and allolddefinitions exact;new definition/unit illegal on unrelated quantities;oldpositivequantity rules unchanged

cases.name: duplicate_metadata
cases.requirement: Same sourcecell cannot gain coverage by notes,evidence aliases,unknownknown enrichment or formula whitespace;check both insertion orders

cases.name: distinct_cells
cases.requirement: Actual distinct source cells or reported separate protocols remain separate,without inferring independent specimens

cases.name: no_cross_transfer
cases.requirement: No lignin method,DSC sample mass/program,mechanical n,precursor80°C12h or hotpress geometry assigned to actual gel aliquot

cases.name: end_to_end
cases.requirement: Four-language query/resolve/full source-qualified export/restore preserves Wlabels,unknowns,source rights;actual isolated installed package checked before acceptance
